physical_mechanism: Unmodified Physical-D from e288eee: L20 hidden exit, L2-L5 answer attention skip, compact KV; no persistent original image keys.
preflight_selection: Stratify category and options; shortest/median/longest per stratum with unique images; fill to >=24 by SHA256 rank; no gold/output used.
preflight_stop: Any empty output/repetition; all non-OCR abnormal EOS/truncation; obvious POPE/MME/ScienceQA/MMBench explanation; unexplained GQA/TextVQA verbosity. OCR genuine text allowed; two consecutive cap hits per method stop.
full_run_stop: Same abnormal output rules; no cap/prompt adjustment based on accuracy. Every anomalous prediction retained and scored; affected benchmark paused.

bootstrap.multiplicity: Ordinary unadjusted CIs; seven benchmarks and subgroups are multiple descriptive comparisons.
